title: RemoteOK.io: a single PHP file generating $2,342.04 a day, no frameworks or libraries
summary: Pieter Levels shares that RemoteOK.io runs on one PHP file, index.php, and earned $2,342.04 in a single day. The post argues that a minimal stack with no frameworks or libraries can still produce serious revenue.

principles.text: A real, revenue-generating product can run on one simple file; heavy frameworks and libraries aren't required.
principles.quote: RemoteOK.io is a single PHP file called "index.php" generating $2,342.04 in a day. No frameworks. No libraries.
